meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Coordinate supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals. Use Computer Use for external browser windows, webviews, Orca app UI, or desktop UI outside Orca's embedded browser only when the task requires OS/window-level control such as focus, menus, dialogs, coordinates, or screenshots. Use `orca-cli` for Orca's embedded pages and a page-automation tool such as Playwright or CDP for external pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 统筹多个 AI 工人,分步交接并监督任务执行进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把复杂任务拆给多个 AI 工人,并保持过程可控可见。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate several AI workers to split tasks and oversee step-by-step progress.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage several AI assistants and want visible, controlled delegation across them.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 Orca 运行时协调多个受监管的 worker:发线程消息、阻塞式一问一答、派发任务、等 worker 完成或升级、按任务 DAG 和决策门推进,并把工作拆给多个代理。它必须先加载与二进制匹配的指南再执行命令。
howto.when: 当你需要结构化的多代理协调——如任务 DAG、决策门、等待 worker 完成等——时接管;若只是交接所有权、普通终端或 shell 操作,则改用 orca-cli 技能。

say.text: 把这项工作拆成任务 DAG,分派给几个 worker 并等它们回来
say.note: 会派发任务并阻塞等待 worker_done

say.text: 给这个 worker 发条线程消息,问它进度然后等回复
say.note: 走阻塞式 ask/reply 流程

say.text: 起一个协调循环监控各 worker,有升级就告诉我
say.note: 进入协调循环并处理升级

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude coordinates supervised Orca workers via the Orca runtime: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, waiting on worker_done or escalation, task DAGs and decision gates, splitting work across agents. It loads the version-matched guide before running commands.
howto.when_en: Engage when you need structured multi-agent coordination, such as task DAGs, decision gates, or waiting on workers. For ownership handoffs, ordinary terminal or shell work, use the orca-cli skill instead.

say_en.text: Split this work into a task DAG, dispatch it to several workers, and wait for them
say_en.note: Dispatches tasks and blocks on worker_done

say_en.text: Send this worker a threaded message asking for status, then wait for the reply
Run a coordinator loop over the workers and tell me about escalations
say_en.note: Enters the coordinator loop and handles escalation
